title: Pod world?
content: I have a place that I dream of at least a couple times a year that reminds of the mall world dreams. It has a very similar feeling and I always feel unsettled once I wake up. As with my mall world dreams I am always with a group people that I know very well in my dream world, but they are not people I know in real life. I am in a control room of sorts and you can enter different worlds by going through certain doorways. When in the control room you can watch the different worlds, as they seem to be encased in glass pods. The control room has a very steampunk vibe and the worlds are all different. One that stands out is like a rainforest. I hardly ever remember what happens once I go through the door into the pod, but the control room is very vivid. What it reminds me of the most is the map in the old Super Nintendo Mario games where you can move from place to place and then pick the “world” you want to enter. Just wondering if anyone else has dreamed anything like this?
